title: Pods miss the engine assets: one-shot install dies with the first Pod
description: On RunPod, the volume-installed engine assets (taef2 preview decoder, sam3-multiplex, qwen3vl-abliterated-clip, hand-yolov8n) can be missing for a whole app session. Seen 2026-10-09 on Pod 6mtshnzc61jz87: its ComfyUI lists none of them, so every FLUX.2 Klein live preview falls back to Latent2RGB (looks like crap; final images fine) and SAM3 masking / the Qwen3-VL describer would fail there. Likely cause: js/shell.js runs _installRemoteEngineAssets ONCE per app session behind the _didFirstConnectDriftCheck latch, silently; today the first connect was a CPU Pod deleted 36 s later, the install died with it, and the GPU Pod never retried. Prove with app restart + reconnect, then fix: run the (deduped) install on every connect edge and log a failed silent job. Evidence in brief.md.
